title: Universal scalar counits uniquely normalize shifts
statement: For any map a of commutative ring sheaves on the small pro-etale site, there exists a unique coherent integer CommShift structure on pbcDerivedExtend a for which the actual universal scalar counit commutes with shifts. This records the already proved scalarCommShift_existsUnique helper, not the later integral coefficient comparison theorem. Underlying definitions are those of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site].

source.place: Tags 05SU, 06YU, 07A6, 0B56, 0941, 099I, 099L; retained canonical scalar-shift argument of lem-pur-compact-support-scalar-shift-normalization.

proof.text: Apply coherent right-Kan shift existence. Postcomposing the universal pair with each integer shift equivalence preserves its Kan property. The two counit squares coincide, and injectivity of that Kan Hom map forces equality of each shift isomorphism. Structure extensionality and proof irrelevance give equality of coherent shifts.
